text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: "Put this book back, and that's done! Now, shall I go get the next job?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer.
I'm helping out the library committee.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: The upcoming ticket war is going to be fierce, so I need to build up as much good karma as possible...!

In other words, it seems she's accumulating good deeds
to bring good luck and increase her chances of winning ticket lotteries.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um... Digital-san, er...
I-I'm terribly sorry, but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy-san...!
Ah, is there more work? What should I do?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
T-Thank you so much!
Actually, I wanted to collect some overdue books.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Could you please come along with me
to visit the people on this list...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Leave the negotiations
with the people on the list to me.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Th-Thank you, that helps a lot...! Since everyone here is a Trainer, I was feeling a bit nervous...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"It's nerve-wracking dealing with adults you've never met before, right?
I interact with them a lot through my hobbies,
so I'm used to it!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Well, shall we go? Who's first?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Umm... it's <username>.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
Let us head to the Trainer's room.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"—No, I already knew this, but...
Trainer, your desk is practically
forming geological layers."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that they couldn't find where the book was,
so they weren't able to return it...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It can't be helped... Shall we tidy up the geological layers?
I'll borrow an empty box.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Now then... Book, stationery, trash, book, book, disc,
book, book, trash, stationery, book...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
S-So fast...! Sorting them into empty boxes by type...
and she doesn't even look at her hands, yet makes zero mistakes...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, found the library books.
While I'm at it, I might as well put away the stuff in this box too!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It was cleaned up in no time at all...
Not only that, the books are neatly sorted by category, and the stationery is stored so it's easy to use.
choice_data_list: You're good at tidying up, huh!
You're good at tidying up, aren't you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I've got a lot of stuff in my room too,
so I'm pretty used to organizing books and merch.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: At this rate, let's collect the books from the other Trainers too!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... What was up with those rooms...?
I really shouldn't have brought Rob Roy along with me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Forget geological strata, this was a whole shell midden!
What on earth happened to the Trainer's room?!
Well, I cleaned it all up for you anyway!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
You managed to clean up so fast.
I basically just stood by and watched... I'm so sorry.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
No, I volunteered to help out myself.
Besides, cleaning up is just my way of building good karma.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
V-Virtue...? But, well,
I don't really see an end in sight to this...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I have to do something about this.
If I don't finish, my virtue... my virtue will go into the negative...
choice_data_list: Let's cut down on the time we spend per person!
We'll just have to tidy up little by little.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...You're right.
Let's change our strategy and focus solely on retrieving the books!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
First, I'll prepare a return request message card,
thereby cutting down on time spent explaining.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Let's hand those cards out to the Trainers
on the list! That way we can split up the work!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes...!
If I just have to hand it over, I shouldn't be too nervous.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I've already mapped out Umamusume-chan's movements,
so I can deduce where her Trainer is too!
Alright, let's dash over and hand them out!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
...Here to return this book. Sorry for taking so long.
Still, nice job figuring out I'd be under the overpass. Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
That person just now was the last one.
I'm glad we finished surprisingly early!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Digital-san,
thank you so very much.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Always striving to build up virtue...
You're just like a legendary hero, I truly admire you...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hauu! ...Y-Your smile... it's blinding...! 
............Uuugh...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: (I could never admit this late in the game that it was just to increase my chances of winning the ticket lottery...!!!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Right... It's a quota I set for myself
because I originally wanted to build up good karma, after all...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um... Digital-san, please don't push yourself.
Thank you so very much for today.
It was a huge help...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Ah... Aahh... Rob Roy-san's smile...
It overflows with such kindness... Haaahn, it's so soothing..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
—Recharge complete! Digi-tan is fully revived!!
Thank you for letting me bathe in my faves!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'll go clean up the rest!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Book retrieval & filthy room extermination complete!!
Man, you wouldn't believe how many times I thought 'I should just burn it all down!' I'm so glad it's over!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? You've already finished cleaning up the rooms
for everyone on the list!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I-Incredible... This is a miracle...!
Even though she was so exhausted just a moment ago.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
As long as I have the smile of my beloved Rob Roy-san,
I can bounce back again and again!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...S-So cool...!
Just like the protagonist of the Hero Umamusume series...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hawa, Rob Roy-san's eyes are sparkling...
S-So cute... This is the best reward everrr...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...T-This didn't just use up all my luck, did it!?
That doesn't count, right!?
